canonical_name: Critical Functions and Risk Not Considered for Post-Incident Norms
description: Critical mission functions and risk management are not considered to establish post-incident operational norms.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations with business continuity and disaster recovery requirements Incident recovery and restoration teams Communications and public relations functions Organizations with regulatory recovery requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Identify recovery scenarios where operations resume without risk assessment updates or critical function reviews. Monitor for missing post-incident evaluations of acceptable risk levels, residual vulnerabilities, or changes to operational baselines following significant incidents.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls
